place: Squamish Valley Golf Club, 2458 Mamquam Road
preview: This is the first meeting of the newly elected council, where Mayor Easton and six councillors are sworn in. Council will also name who serves as acting mayor each month, pick representatives for regional and local boards, and set the 2027 meeting schedule.

agenda_items.plain: Mayor Easton and Councillors Andersen, DesJardins, Ellis, Perreault, Prosko and Veltkamp take their oaths of office before a judge to begin their term.
agenda_items.for_you: These are the seven people who will make decisions for Squamish over the coming term.

agenda_items.plain: Council will vote on who represents Squamish on the Squamish-Lillooet Regional District Board: Mayor Easton with 5 votes, and Councillors Ellis and Andersen with 4 votes each, with Councillors Prosko, Perreault and Veltkamp as backups.
Council will vote on a rotating list of councillors who will fill in as acting mayor each month from November 2026 to December 2027.
Council will vote to appoint Councillors Andersen, Prosko and Veltkamp to the Land Back Task Force until the end of 2027.
Council will vote to appoint Councillors Ellis and Perreault to the Community Forest Board, and Councillor DesJardins to the Squamish Library Board, until the end of 2027.
Council will vote on its 2027 schedule of regular meetings, usually on the first and third Mondays of the month, with no meetings in August and one in September.
agenda_items.for_you: Regular council meetings in 2027 start at 6 p.m. at Municipal Hall, 37955 Second Avenue, with the first on January 5.

agenda_items.plain: Mayor Easton gives his opening speech for the new term, followed by remarks from each councillor.
The mayor and each councillor may invite one community member to speak to council for up to three minutes.
